title: Strict scalar/tensor transport on good localization representatives
statement: In the setting of [stage3-pur-scalar-tensor-limit-strict-witness], the strict K-flat equation yields the realized equality for every pair of good localization representatives and every bridge from scalar extension of the E tensor to the completed L tensor.

source.place: K-flat good representatives, SY/TL normalization, and strict scalar/tensor naturality

proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: The proposed normalization argument does not constrain the arbitrary bridge beta. Taking beta = 0 forces the fixed right-hand coordinate to vanish. For complete inputs the canonical scalarTensorCompleted isomorphism supplies another beta, so cancellation also forces the whole left postcomposition to vanish. Strict K-flat scalar/tensor compatibility does not assert either vanishing. The original theorem remains unproved; its intended normalization/localization route needs a specified canonical bridge.

Diagnostic proved in Lean, without using the disputed theorem: on complete inputs scalarTensorCompleted gives an isomorphism between the bridge objects. For maps f and g, the assertion that beta followed by f equals g for every beta is equivalent to f = 0 and g = 0. Evaluate at the zero bridge for g = 0, evaluate at the canonical isomorphism and cancel it for f = 0, and use composition with zero for the converse.

proof_origin.place: A7, 2026-10-28: the arbitrary-bridge vanishing diagnostic is proved independently; the original assertion is marked STATEMENT-DISPUTED and its single hole is retained.
